2.0.26: Actually applied the fix for small playlists not updating their song count when skipping songs.
2.0.25: Intelligently disable playlist estimation for playlists under 80 songs so they are completely immune to Shuffle+ bugs and track index glitches!
2.0.24: Fixed a bug where restarting a playlist would show the wrong song count because it remembered your previous spot in the queue.
2.0.23: Fixed a bug where the settings menu button would duplicate multiple times.
2.0.22: Fixed an issue where the extension would crash if the Spotify queue was populated by a third-party app like Shuffle+.
2.0.21: Enabled Full Playlist Estimation by default for all sizes, meaning the queue time will perfectly match the time shown at the top of your playlist!
Added local storage persistence so your place in the queue is remembered even if you completely close or restart Spotify.
2.0.20: The queue song count now correctly includes the currently playing track again so that the math perfectly matches your expectations.
2.0.19: Fixed an issue where Spotify's background track-switching caused the index to skip by 1.
Reverted the song count change to purely count upcoming tracks again.
2.0.18: The displayed song count now correctly includes the currently playing track so it mathematically matches the remaining time!
2.0.17: Fixed an issue where small playlists with Repeat enabled would artificially inflate the queue to 80 songs.
2.0.16: Fixed a crash (ReferenceError) caused by a variable scoping issue in the new manual index tracker.
2.0.15: Added manual track index tracking for users whose Spotify client does not report the current track index natively.
2.0.14: Removed the '~' symbol from the time display for a cleaner UI.
Removed Calc Mode from settings; Full Playlist Estimation is now the default and only mode.
2.0.13: Fixed a bug where manually queued tracks were excluded from the total song count when Full Playlist Estimation was active.
2.0.12: Fixed overlapping text in 'In-Queue Text' layout by switching to true inline injection.
2.0.11: Fixed an edge case where Spotify reports the current track index in a non-standard way, breaking playlist estimation.
2.0.10: Added aggressive diagnostic logging to debug playlist estimation.
2.0.9: Added Hot Reloading for Seamless Updates! Queue Time will now update itself perfectly without needing a Spotify restart!
2.0.8: Made Full Playlist Estimation completely bulletproof by using three different internal APIs to fetch playlist lengths.
2.0.7: Fixed Queue Time displaying incorrectly in the Queue page layout due to Spotify UI updates.
Re-implemented the classic non-destructive layout injection.
2.0.6: Fixed Full Playlist Estimation crashing due to Spotify API 429 rate limits.
Added zero-latency local Cosmos API fallback for instant estimation.
2.0.5: Added Full Playlist Time Estimation (bypasses 80 song limit)!
Updated settings UI text to be more accurate (showing seconds).
2.0.4: Added a sleek, native-feeling premium settings menu with rounded edges and micro-animations.
Added this beautiful startup changelog popup (brought over from Beautiful Release Date) so you always know what's new.
2.0.3: Added save queue to playlist button
